svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, Vite, GSAP, Figma. Backend y datos: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, Supabase, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, JWT, Stripe, PayPal, MercadoPago. IA y automatización: OpenAI, LangChain, RAG, n8n, WhatsApp API, Zoho CRM, Meta Cloud API, Webhooks. Nube y herramientas: Vercel, Google Cloud, AWS, Docker, Ubuntu, Git, GitHub, Postman, Claude Code
